hypothesis: The Compile stage still dies after attempts 1 and 2 because they treated the symptom (net declarations) instead of the source. Every one of the repeated 'sorry: constant selects in always_* processes are not currently supported (all bits will be included)' notes is emitted when a module assigns only a constant bit/part-select on the LHS of an always_comb/always_ff/always_latch (e.g. an indexed cache valid/tag array word, a BHT 2-bit counter slice, a byte-enable field, or a packed control vector). Icarus Verilog cannot narrow such a select, so it widens the assignment to the WHOLE vector. When the same vector is also assigned/reset from another always block or read elsewhere, the widened driver collides and elaboration reports the leftover '5 error(s) during elaboration' (unable-to-bind / multiple-driver / port-expression class). The 'sorry' lines and the 5 errors are therefore one defect, not two: the always_* constant-select pattern itself. The durable fix is at the assignment sites — write full vectors (compute the value into a temporary/local and assign the entire signal, or use indexed memory writes only inside plain always @(posedge clk) with whole-word targets) rather than patching net declarations in the top.
constraints: Do not change any port name/width/direction of rv32i5, icache, dcache, branch_predictor, fetch_unit or alu as frozen in the interface contract.
Keep synchronous active-low reset; every registered output (including dmem_valid, cache idle/valid, BTB/BHT valid) must be 0 during reset and before the first reset edge.
Keep the single-cycle memory model: imem/dmem respond same cycle; do not register responses or add wait states.
Do not touch the teacher TB, spec, or scoring scripts; no hardcoded vectors, no faked debug/feature flags (dbg_features stays 3'b111).
Preserve module boundaries and file names; do not merge modules back into the top.
Squash/redirect and cache flush semantics (flush/flush_epoch) must remain valid-with-data-same-cycle; ready backpressure must not drop requests.
Whenever a signal is written under an always_* block, assign the full vector (no constant bit/part select on the LHS); each net must remain single-driver.
